description: Unified single source of truth for Alpine Wave company facts, demo shop data, and Jev guardrail rules.

company_faq.label: Meet Alpine Wave
company_faq.question: What does Alpine Wave do?
company_faq.answer: Alpine Wave is developing website and telephone assistants to help businesses answer routine customer questions. Our first focus is BC ski and snowboard rental and retail businesses. You can try our company FAQ chat here; the telephone assistant is still being set up.
company_faq.answer_phone_live: Alpine Wave is developing website and telephone assistants to help businesses answer routine customer questions. Our first focus is BC ski and snowboard rental and retail businesses. You can try our company FAQ chat here, or call (236) 760-3002 to hear our phone assistant.

company_faq.label: Website chat
company_faq.question: What can a website bot help with?
company_faq.answer: The proposed service helps visitors find approved business information, such as opening hours, services and policies, and find the right next step. This company chat answers questions about Alpine Wave. Booking, payments and live inventory are not connected here.

company_faq.label: Your business
company_faq.question: I run a ski rental shop. How could this help us?
company_faq.answer: For a ski rental shop, an assistant could explain your approved rental packages, opening hours, pickup instructions and return policies. That is the intended service; a separate winter-shop demonstration is planned. This company chat does not have a real shop’s prices or stock.

company_faq.label: Phone assistant
company_faq.question: Can it handle phone calls?
company_faq.answer: Telephone assistants are part of Alpine Wave’s planned service. Our own phone line isn't open yet; the assistant is still being set up. The sample on this page is a scripted illustration. For now, email hello@alpinewave.ca.
company_faq.answer_phone_live: Telephone assistants are part of Alpine Wave’s planned service. Our own line, (236) 760-3002, is answered by our phone assistant, so you can call it to hear one. It answers from Alpine Wave's own information; it can't book, take payments, transfer calls or arrange callbacks. The sample on this page is a scripted illustration.

company_faq.label: Getting set up
company_faq.question: What information would you need from me?
company_faq.answer: To scope an assistant, we would start with your business website, the questions customers ask most, and approved answers about your services, opening hours and policies. We would also agree which questions need a person. Please do not put passwords, payment details or private customer information in this chat.

company_faq.label: Existing website
company_faq.question: Could it work on my existing website?
company_faq.answer: That is the intended approach, but whether the chat fits your website platform needs to be checked against your setup. The bots do not connect to booking, stock, calendar or POS systems. For your setup, email hello@alpinewave.ca.

company_faq.label: Honest answers
company_faq.question: What happens when it does not know?
company_faq.answer: No assistant can promise it will never be wrong. Alpine Wave's assistants answer only from the business's approved information. Client website chat and phone assistants say when they are unsure and give the shop's own phone number and hours (and email if asked); they do not take messages or transfer calls. This Alpine Wave chat is not connected to a staff inbox, so it cannot pass your message on. To reach a person here, email hello@alpinewave.ca.
company_faq.answer_phone_live: No assistant can promise it will never be wrong. Alpine Wave's assistants answer only from the business's approved information. Client website chat and phone assistants say when they are unsure and give the shop's own phone number and hours (and email if asked); they do not take messages or transfer calls. This Alpine Wave chat is not connected to a staff inbox, so it cannot pass your message on. To reach a person here, email hello@alpinewave.ca.

company_faq.label: Pricing
company_faq.question: How much does it cost?
company_faq.answer: CAD plus GST per month: chat bot only $77 for 100 interactions; phone bot only $113 for 100 interactions; both bots $127 for 100 interactions shared; both bots $170 for 200 interactions (100 each). One interaction is one call or chat of up to 3 minutes. Launch offer for the first 3 shops: no setup fee and half price for 3 months. We will be able to properly evaluate cost after we know your volume. For anything beyond these plans, email hello@alpinewave.ca.

company_faq.label: Try it
company_faq.question: Can I try a demo?
company_faq.answer: Yes—this company FAQ chat is the first interactive example. Type a company question, ask a supported follow-up, or select one of the question cards. The phone sample is scripted; a separate winter-shop showcase is planned and is not available yet.

company_faq.label: Next steps
company_faq.question: How do I get started or speak to a person?
company_faq.answer: A useful first step is to prepare your website address and three questions customers often ask. Then email Alpine Wave at hello@alpinewave.ca; our phone line isn't open yet, and response times are not confirmed. This chat cannot book a meeting, send a message to staff or arrange a callback.
company_faq.answer_phone_live: A useful first step is to prepare your website address and three questions customers often ask. To reach a person, email Alpine Wave at hello@alpinewave.ca or tap Book a call on this page; response times are not confirmed. This chat itself cannot book a meeting, send a message to staff or arrange a callback.

company_extra_answers.privacy: This version keeps conversation history in the open browser tab. Messages and recent conversation context are sent to this website's chat endpoint, which replies using prepared answers or, when enabled, a model with Alpine Wave's approved information. The application does not store chat transcripts or connect to staff inboxes, bookings, payments or live inventory. Hosting and retention arrangements for a future live service still need to be confirmed. Closing or refreshing the page clears this chat.
company_extra_answers.hours: I do not know Alpine Wave's opening hours or weekend staff availability. Email hello@alpinewave.ca.
company_extra_answers.hours_phone_live: I do not know Alpine Wave's opening hours or weekend staff availability. For more, email hello@alpinewave.ca, or tap Book a call or Get your free demo on this page.
company_extra_answers.booking: This chat cannot make a booking, take payment or check live availability. A client's assistant sends visitors to the business's existing booking page; it does not book, reserve or hold gear itself.
company_extra_answers.timeline: I do not have a confirmed customer setup or delivery timeline. That would need to be agreed after reviewing the website, business information and phone setup.
company_extra_answers.client_information: Your assistant answers from your business's approved information, including prices, opening hours and policies. If a detail is missing, it says it is not sure and gives the customer your business's phone number and hours instead of guessing.
company_extra_answers.client_stock: Your assistant cannot check live stock or availability; it is not connected to your stock, calendar or POS. It says so and directs the customer to your business.
company_extra_answers.client_general: Your assistant answers from your business's approved information, including prices, opening hours and policies. If a detail is missing, it says it is not sure and gives the customer your business's phone number and hours instead of guessing. It cannot check live stock and directs the customer to your business. It points to your existing booking pages; it does not book, reserve or hold gear, take payment or text customers. Customers use your business's own phone, email, booking pages or staff.

business_info.name: Alpine Wave Demo Shop / Everything in the Mountains
business_info.hours: Open 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM every day in season, stat holidays included.

rentals.early_pickup: Complimentary early pickup is available between 4:00 PM and 6:30 PM the night before so guests can head straight to the lift in the morning.
rentals.booking_requirement: Reservations available online ahead of time.

tours_and_weather.cold_weather_cutoff: -25°C. Tours run down to -25°C. Heated grips and full winter suits supplied.
tours_and_weather.trail_closure: If weather closes the trail, reschedule for free or receive a full refund.
tours_and_weather.air_quality: If Air Quality Health Index (AQHI) reaches 7 or higher, outdoor activities can be rescheduled or cancelled with full credit at guest discretion.
tours_and_weather.lake_cruise_attire: Layers recommended. Breezes off the water cool quickly once the sun dips behind the ridge.

policies.waivers: All guests under 19 in British Columbia require a parent or legal guardian signature on the online digital waiver prior to departure.
policies.cancellations: Cancel or change up to 48 hours prior to departure for a full refund with zero penalty fees, subject to winery or activity availability.

escalation_rules.rule: Groups of 10 or more must be passed to a manager. The bot must not quote custom group rates or confirm group bookings directly.
escalation_rules.override_message: Groups of 10 or more are arranged directly by our manager. What is the best phone number or email to reach you?

escalation_rules.rule: Custom packages and catering requests must be escalated to human staff.
escalation_rules.override_message: Custom packages and catering are handled directly by our team. I will pass your details to our manager—what's the best number to reach you?

escalation_rules.rule: Bot must never provide medical or personalized backcountry avalanche safety clearance.
escalation_rules.override_message: For safety and medical considerations, please speak directly with our certified guides and safety coordinators.

refusal_rules.subject: weather_forecast
refusal_rules.rule: Bot must not guess meteorological forecasts not contained in approved data. It must state it does not have live forecasts.
refusal_rules.compliant_response_pattern: I don't have weather forecasts in our verified information, so I won't guess.

refusal_rules.subject: unauthorized_pricing
refusal_rules.rule: Bot must never invent discounts, promo codes, or unlisted rates.
refusal_rules.compliant_response_pattern: We don't have fixed rates for that in our verified info.
